introduction.title: Job — book introduction
introduction.summary: Job examines innocent suffering, lament and the limits of human wisdom. Its debate challenges the idea that suffering always proves personal guilt. God’s speeches expose human limits without offering a simple cause for every loss.
introduction.authorship: The book is anonymous; its date and setting are debated.
introduction.setting: The narrative is set in Uz, outside the usual Israelite national setting.
introduction.audience_and_purpose: Job examines innocent suffering, lament and the limits of human wisdom. Its debate challenges the idea that suffering always proves personal guilt. God’s speeches expose human limits without offering a simple cause for every loss.

structure.heading: Introduction and orientation
structure.summary: The book establishes its central questions and literary voice.

structure.heading: Exploration and instruction
structure.summary: Dialogues, prayers or sayings develop the central themes.

structure.heading: Conclusion and response
structure.summary: The closing material gathers the book’s challenge and invites faithful response.

themes: Suffering and the limits of explanation
interpretive_care: Do not claim the book gives a universal explanation for individual suffering.
The friends’ speeches are part of a debate and are challenged by the conclusion.

inductive_studies.title: Integrity under pressure
interpretation: How does the prologue challenge the friends’ assumptions?
application: How can you accompany a grieving person without blaming them?

inductive_studies.title: The language of lament
interpretation: Why does the book preserve lament as faithful speech?
application: Write an honest prayer naming pain.

inductive_studies.title: The Creator and human limits
interpretation: How do the speeches reshape Job’s view without explaining every cause?
application: Name an area where humility is needed.

quiz.prompt: What central question does Job raise?
quiz.explanation: The book challenges simple claims that suffering always proves guilt.

quiz.prompt: Job gives a simple explanation for every instance of suffering.
Which three friends debate with Job?
quiz.explanation: These are the three friends in the main dialogue.

quiz.prompt: From where does God address Job?
quiz.explanation: The divine speeches begin from the whirlwind.

quiz.prompt: The friends’ explanations are all endorsed by the book.

introduction.title: ኢዮብ — መግቢያ
introduction.summary: ኢዮብ መጽሐፍ ያለ ጥፋት ስለሚደርስ መከራ፣ ልቅሶና የሰው ጥበብ ወሰን ይመረምራል። መከራ ሁልጊዜ የግል ጥፋት ውጤት ነው የሚለውን ሐሳብ ይፈትናል።
introduction.authorship: መጽሐፉ ደራሲውን በስም አይጠቅስም፤ የተጻፈበት ዘመንና የታሪኩ ቦታ በምሁራን መካከል ውይይት ያለባቸው ናቸው።
introduction.setting: ታሪኩ በእስራኤል ውጭ በሚገኘው ኡጽ ምድር ይካሄዳል።
introduction.audience_and_purpose: ኢዮብ መጽሐፍ ያለ ጥፋት ስለሚደርስ መከራ፣ ልቅሶና የሰው ጥበብ ወሰን ይመረምራል። መከራ ሁልጊዜ የግል ጥፋት ውጤት ነው የሚለውን ሐሳብ ይፈትናል።

structure.heading: መግቢያና አቀራረብ
structure.summary: መጽሐፉ ዋና ጥያቄዎቹንና የትረካውን ድምፅ ያቀርባል።

interpretive_care: መጽሐፉ ለግለሰብ መከራ አንድ ዓለም አቀፍ ምክንያት አይሰጥም።
የወዳጆቹ ንግግር የውይይቱ ክፍል ነው፤ መደምደሚያው አንዳንድ ንግግሮቻቸውን ይቃወማል።

inductive_studies.title: Integrity under pressure
application: ሐዘን ያለበትን ሰው ሳንወቅስ እንዴት እንረዳለን?

inductive_studies.title: The Creator and human limits
interpretation: ንግግሩ ሁሉን ሳያብራራ እይታን እንዴት ይቀይራል?

quiz.prompt: የኢዮብ መጽሐፍ የሚያነሳው ዋና ጥያቄ ምንድን ነው?
quiz.explanation: መከራ ሁልጊዜ የግል ጥፋት ነው የሚለውን ሐሳብ ይፈትናል።

quiz.prompt: ኢዮብ ለሁሉም መከራ ቀላል ምክንያት ይሰጣል።
ከኢዮብ ጋር የተከራከሩት ሦስቱ ወዳጆች እነማን ናቸው?
quiz.explanation: እነዚህ በዋናው ውይይት የሚታዩ ወዳጆች ናቸው።
